git.title: Git editing
git.intro: Each page has its own repository containing page.md. Use any username and your Git token as the password.
git.limits: Only linear fast-forward updates to main are supported. History replacement, branch deletion, tags and merge commits are rejected. Limit: 40 commits and 4 MiB per push; page.md at most 512 KiB. Initial import includes up to 20 revisions; fetch includes up to 100 visible commits. Hidden or purged revisions form a shallow boundary. A batch of Git commits creates one Wiki revision.
git.tokenHint: The token is shown once and expires in 30 days. Rotating or revoking immediately invalidates the previous token. Page permissions and ACLs still apply. Git author fields are not verified identities.
